description:
Set of two polished agate geode halves that work as bookends. The cut faces show white and clear crystal formations with a peach colored center and a tan outer band. The rough backs are tinted teal blue and the bottoms are flat so each piece stands upright. Each piece is a natural stone, so color and pattern differ slightly from one half to the other.

Condition: Rough natural edges along the outer rim. Small white chalky patches on the rim of one piece. A small square of paper residue is on the base of one piece. No cracks seen.

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping

.

The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Lionel Postwar O Gauge Flatcar Lot - 2 Pieces With Original Boxes
No. 6801 Flatcar with Boat & No. 6477 Bulkhead Flatcar with Pipe Load
Postwar Era, Made in USA
This vintage lot features two classic Postwar Lionel O gauge freight cars accompanied by their original boxes. Included are the No. 6801 flatcar equipped with its white cradle and blue-and-white plastic cabin cruiser boat, along with the No. 6477 bulkhead flatcar carrying a structural pipe load secured between side stakes. Produced during the late 1950s, these workhorse freight cars showcase the ingenuity and charm of Lionel's golden era of model railroading.
Lionel No. 6801 red flatcar with white cradle and blue/white runabout boat marked 6801-50
Lionel No. 6477 red bulkhead flatcar with black end racks, vertical side stakes, and pipe load
Both cars feature operational knuckle couplers and die-cast metal trucks
Includes two original Lionel Corporation classic orange-and-blue illustrated boxes
Condition:
Flatcars display light play wear consistent with age, including faint surface scuffs and light oxidation on metal axles and couplers. The boat shows mild dust accumulation and age-related toning to the cream plastic deck. Pipe load exhibits minor surface marks. Both boxes have shelf wear, edge creasing, and flap wear, with one box missing end flaps. Complete as pictured.

- Sample Bags: Labeled 'Petrified Wood' and 'Crinoid' with informational cards

- Colors: White, Pink, Gray, Brown, Blue
- Total Weight: 6 pounds

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.
